products.title: ExpertBook B1 14” Business Laptop
products.description: The ASUS ExpertBook B1 (B1403CVA-XS54) is a professional 14-inch business laptop designed for productivity and durability. It features an Intel Core i5-1335U processor, 16GB of DDR5 RAM, and a 512GB PCIe 4.0 SSD for fast performance. The device is equipped with a 14-inch FHD anti-glare display, a backlit chiclet keyboard, and a wide array of I/O ports including USB-C with power delivery. Built to withstand rigorous use, it meets the US MIL-STD 810H military-grade standard and comes in a professional Gentle Grey finish.

images.alt_text: ASUS ExpertBook laptop in grey and black, viewed from above and slightly angled.

products.title: HP ProBook 440 G11 Business Laptop
products.description: The HP ProBook 440 G11 is a professional-grade business laptop featuring a 14-inch FHD+ (1920x1200) display and the Intel Core Ultra 5 125U processor with dedicated NPU AI acceleration for enhanced productivity. It comes equipped with 16GB of DDR5 RAM and a 512GB PCIe M.2 SSD for fast performance and secure storage. Designed for security and collaboration, it includes a fingerprint reader, HP Wolf Security, a backlit keyboard, and a built-in webcam. The slim silver chassis houses a long-lasting lithium-ion battery and a wide range of connectivity options, including Wi-Fi 6, dual USB Type-C, and HDMI ports. It runs on Windows 11 Pro.

products.title: Dell Pro 5 Series 14" Business Laptop
products.description: The Dell Pro 5 Series 14" Business Laptop is a professional-grade computer featuring an Intel Core Ultra 5 335 vPro processor with 8 cores and a built-in NPU for AI tasks. It is equipped with 16GB of DDR5 RAM and a 512GB SSD for fast storage and performance. The device boasts a 14-inch WUXGA (1920 x 1200) non-touch display with 400 nits brightness, anti-glare coating, and low power consumption. Additional features include an FHD RGB + IR camera with presence detection and a shutter for security, a Mini-LED backlit keyboard, and Windows 11 Pro, making it a Copilot+ PC.

products.title: EliteBook 640 G11 14" FHD+ Business Laptop
products.description: This HP EliteBook 640 G11 business laptop offers premium commercial use with AI-enhanced features for secure and easy management. It is powered by an Intel Core Ultra 7 155U processor, 16GB DDR5 RAM, and a 512GB PCIe NVMe M.2 SSD for efficient multitasking and fast storage. The 14" WUXGA (1920 x 1200) UWVA IPS display with anti-glare and 300 nits brightness provides sharp visuals. Connectivity includes 2x USB-A 3.2 Gen 1, 2x Thunderbolt 4, HDMI 2.1, Ethernet, and a headphone/microphone combo jack. It also features Intel Wi-Fi 6E, Bluetooth 5.3, and a backlit keyboard. Security features include TPM technology and HP Wolf Security, along with an FHD camera with a privacy shutter. Running on Windows 11 Professional 64-bit with AI-powered Copilot, it is ideal for professionals, small businesses, designers, programmers, and more.
